note: Duplicate rows confirmed to be one market, left out of the canonical file by build-consolidated-markets.mjs. Each dropped slug must redirect to the survivor in data/slug-redirects.json. See scripts/lib/merged-markets.mjs.

merges.name: Santa Rosa Community Wednesday Farmers Market
merges.reason: Wednesday row of the Santa Rosa Community Farmers Market in the California WIC dataset. Agricultural Community Events runs one market on Wednesdays and Saturdays; merge approved by Kelly Smith (ACE) by email on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Santa Rosa Community Saturday Farmers Market
merges.reason: Saturday row of the Santa Rosa Community Farmers Market in the California WIC dataset. Agricultural Community Events runs one market on Wednesdays and Saturdays; merge approved by Kelly Smith (ACE) by email on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Petaluma East Side Farmers Market
merges.reason: California WIC dataset row for the Petaluma East Side Farmers' Market at 320 N McDowell Blvd, the same market as the main listing; merge approved by Kelly Smith (ACE) by email on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Petaluma Saturday Certified Farmers Market
merges.reason: California WIC dataset row for the Saturday market at Walnut Park (Petaluma Blvd and D St), filed under the wrong city (Bloomfield); the same market as the Petaluma Walnut Park listing. Fix approved by Kelly Smith (ACE) by email on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Heart of the City Sunday Farmers Market
merges.reason: California WIC dataset row for the Heart of the City Farmers Market at United Nations Plaza (Market St at 7th St), the same market as the main listing; merge approved by the site owner on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Santa Rosa Original Certified Farmers Market
merges.reason: California WIC dataset row for the Santa Rosa Original Certified Farmers Market at 50 Mark West Springs Rd, the same market and address as the main listing; merge approved by the site owner on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Downtown Napa Farmers’ Market
merges.reason: Second legacy row for the Napa Farmers Market, at its old 500 First St address; napafarmersmarket.org gives one market at 1100 West St. Merge approved by the site owner on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Downtown Napa Farmers Market
merges.reason: California WIC dataset row for the Napa Farmers Market at 1100 West St, the same market as the main listing; merge approved by the site owner on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Mission Community Market
merges.reason: California WIC dataset row for the Mission Community Market on Bartlett St, the same Thursday market as the main listing; merge approved by the site owner on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Georgetown Farmers’ Market
merges.reason: Legacy USDA row for the Rose Park Farmers Market at 2600 O St NW, Washington, DC; Friends of Rose Park runs one Wednesday market at 26th and O St NW. Merge requested by the operator by email, recorded on 2026-11-18. The survivor keeps the operator's organizer access.

merges.name: Georgetown Market IN Rose Park
merges.reason: Second legacy USDA row for the Rose Park Farmers Market (26th and O St NW, Washington, DC), with a placeholder phone and a pin about 4 km east of the park. Merge requested by the operator by email, recorded on 2026-11-18.
